title: Cayley, Dedekind, Dirichlet, Gauss, Weber, and Noether: Classical Algebra and Arithmetic LaTeX Drafts
description:
This record is a legacy cross-author shelf for modern LaTeX working drafts of selected classical algebra, arithmetic, and number-theory manuscripts by Cayley, Dedekind, Dirichlet, Gauss, Weber, and Noether. It remains useful as a compact broad browsing and preservation surface, but cleaner author-specific pages are the recommended entry points where they exist. In particular, the separate Weber and Noether records supersede duplicate front-facing Weber/Noether material here while this shelf continues to preserve the broader cluster and earlier checked drafts.

Status at a glance.

  • Technical PDF/display checks: [##########] 21/21 top-level reader PDFs passed structural and short-path display QA before publication.
  • Corpus coverage for this shelf: partial by design; it covers the listed volumes/work groupings, not complete collected works for every author.
  • Mathematical proofreading: 0/21 certified as final critical editions; these are working drafts for checking and correction.
  • Translation: mostly original-language typesetting here. English Weber/Noether translation drafts are linked from the separate author records.

Included author/work groups. Cayley collected mathematical papers volumes IV, VII, X, XI, XII, and XIII; Dedekind Gesammelte Mathematische Werke bands I-III; Dirichlet selected works; Gauss Werke bands I, II, III, VI, VII, XI part I, and individual papers; Weber Lehrbuch der Algebra bands I and III; and Noether selected mathematical papers with collected-volume wrapper material removed.

Workflow. Source scans, witnesses, TeX drafts, render checks, and reference material are organized here for inspection and continuation. Reader-facing files are organized by author, work, corpus, volume, or section; source and process material is kept in artifact ZIPs rather than in public titles or reader PDFs.
version: 2026-05-28 current checked reader shelf; clearer author/title and redundancy notes
notes: Legacy cross-author shelf for Cayley, Dedekind, Dirichlet, Gauss, Weber, and Noether. Separate author pages should be treated as the cleaner public entry point when they exist; this record remains for preservation and broad browsing.
